# Ecclesiastes Chapter 8 -- Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-12

This log records all verses in Ecclesiastes Chapter 8 where the three translators significantly diverged.

---

## 8:1 — "hardness" vs. "boldness" vs. "hard expression"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-boldness of-his-face is-changed" | *oz* = strength/boldness |
| LOGOS | "the hardness of his face is changed" | Traditional |
| PNEUMA | "transforming a hard expression" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "hardness" (LOGOS).

---

## 8:10 — "forgotten" vs. "praised"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "were-forgotten in-the-city" | MT reading (*yishtakechu*) |
| LOGOS | "were praised in the city" | LXX variant (*yishtabbechu*) |
| PNEUMA | "were praised in the very city" | Same LXX reading |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted MT "forgotten" as the harder (and likely original) reading.

**Status:** All resolved.
